source.title: Korin - Wood Warden
source.name: Korin
source.description: A Warrior who has magic arms and is skilled at dealing high damage to ranged enemies.

skills.name: Demonseal Spear

description.raw: Korin sweeps his spear at enemies within 2 tiles, dealing 70% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage 4 times and immobilizing them for 2s. Hitting adjacent enemies will also knock them back 1 tile.
active: Korin sweeps his spear at enemies within 2 tiles, dealing 70% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage 4 times and immobilizing them for 2s.
Hitting adjacent enemies will also knock them back 1 tile.

skills.description_lite: Korin knocks back nearby enemies and immobilizes them.

skills.name: Defiance Charge

description.raw: Korin jumps next to the weakest ally, granting both of them a shield that blocks 300% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage for 5s. Korin then dashes to the closest enemy, dealing 180% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) true damage.
active: Korin jumps next to the weakest ally, granting both of them a shield that blocks 300% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage for 5s.
Korin then dashes to the closest enemy, dealing 180% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) true damage.

skills.description_lite: Korin jumps next to an ally, granting them a shield and dealing true damage to enemies.

skills.name: Air Strike

description.raw: Korin deals a guaranteed critical strike to enemies 1 tile beyond. For every 1% of his crit rate, his critical damage is increased by 1% + 0.1% (SP-based).
active: Korin deals a guaranteed critical strike to enemies 1 tile beyond.
For every 1% of his crit rate, his critical damage is increased by 1% + 0.1% (SP-based).

text: For every 1% of his crit rate, his critical damage is increased by 1.2% + 0.1% (SP-based).
For every 1% of his crit rate, his critical damage is increased by 1.5% + 0.1% (SP-based).
For every 1% of his crit rate, his critical damage is increased by 1.6% + 0.1% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Korin deals a guaranteed critical strike to enemies 1 tile beyond.

skills.name: Vine Arms

description.raw: When Korin and the allies within 2 tiles cast their Ultimates 3 times in total, Korin's arms feel nature's power and enchant his spear with Wilder magic, dealing additional true damage equal to 2% of the targets' max HP for 8s with follow-up attacks, and the extra damage cannot exceed 40% of Korin's ATK.
active: When Korin and the allies within 2 tiles cast their Ultimates 3 times in total, Korin's arms feel nature's power and enchant his spear with Wilder magic, dealing additional true damage equal to 2% of the targets' max HP for 8s with follow-up attacks, and the extra damage cannot exceed 40% of Korin's ATK.

text: Increases ATK SPD by 60 during the skill.
Increases additional true damage to 2.5% of the targets' max HP.
Increases additional true damage to 2.8% of the targets' max HP.

skills.description_lite: Korin deals additional true damage to enemies when he and allied heroes cast a certain amount of Ultimates.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Korin reduces damage taken from enemy beyond 1 tile by 25%.
active: Korin reduces damage taken from enemy beyond 1 tile by 25%.

skills.description_lite: Korin reduces damage taken from enemy beyond 1 tile.
